# Austin Bryan for Bentonville City Council, Ward 1

> Austin Bryan is a Certified Financial Planner (CFP) and Principal/COO at HoganTaylor running for City Council, Ward 1, in Bentonville, Arkansas. Election Day is Tuesday, November 3, 2026 (Arkansas General Election). Campaign slogan: "Sound finances. Smart growth. Vibrant community."

## About Austin Bryan

Austin Bryan is running for Bentonville City Council, Ward 1, because he believes the city must spend better and grow smarter while preserving the unique culture that makes Bentonville vibrant. As a Certified Financial Planner and Principal/COO at HoganTaylor, his career is built on helping people and organizations make disciplined, strategic decisions with their money. He is running to bring that same financial accountability to City Hall.

His civic experience includes: the Plan Bentonville Steering Committee, the Parks & Recreation Advisory Board, the Mayor's Community Council, the Rogers-Lowell Chamber Board, and founding board chair of Leadership Benton County Alumni.

## Platform

### Pillar 1: Sound Finances
Every dollar the City spends belongs to residents. Austin will bring financial discipline and rigorous oversight: rigorous budget oversight, long-term fiscal planning that protects the city from nonessential debt and budget surprises, plain-language budget summaries residents can read before the Council votes, scrutiny of every new bond or debt proposal against its real long-term cost, regular independent reviews of city departments and spending, infrastructure investment prioritized by actual need and long-term value, and protection of the city's reserve funds.

### Pillar 2: Smart, Proactive Growth
Bentonville is among the fastest-growing cities in the region. Austin will push infrastructure and traffic planning to keep pace with expansion, protect the character of established neighborhoods, and mandate that new development pays its fair share toward the roads, water, and infrastructure it requires. He supports a range of housing options across price points and real, meaningful public comment periods before major zoning or land-use changes.

### Pillar 3: Cultivating a Vibrant Community
Austin will champion continued, disciplined investment in local culture, trail systems, public arts, and community spaces: sustained arts and culture funding, world-class parks and trails funded ahead of population growth, preservation of downtown Bentonville's historic character, and support for locally-owned businesses on the square and throughout Bentonville.
